ideas.title: Temporal palimpsest
ideas.vision: Overlay multiple pinned eras of a system as translucent architectural layers.

ideas.title: Commit constellations
ideas.vision: See commits cluster by the capabilities they moved, not just by calendar or file.

ideas.title: Source memory capsule
ideas.vision: Open the exact evidence and assumptions that existed when an old decision was made.

ideas.title: First appearance detector
ideas.vision: Trace a concept's earliest *evidenced* appearance across approved sources.

ideas.title: Capability half-life
ideas.vision: Explore how long a capability's contracts stay stable after successive rewrites.

ideas.title: History compression
ideas.vision: Summarize years of evolution into a handful of verifiable turning points.

ideas.title: Evolution filmstrip
ideas.vision: Scrub a reversible, source-pinned visual story of architectural change.

ideas.title: The missing era
ideas.vision: Show honest blank intervals where no authorized source snapshot is available.

ideas.title: Semantic fossils
ideas.vision: Recognize retired names and comments that still explain present-day structure.

ideas.title: Memory breadcrumbs
ideas.vision: Let a viewer leave a private, provenance-linked note for a future exploration.

ideas.title: Capability genome
ideas.vision: Describe each capability by inputs, outputs, effects, owner, invariants and evidence.

ideas.title: Language-crossing lineage
ideas.vision: Trace a behavior's plausible migration from JS into Rust without equating bytes.

ideas.title: Split-and-fuse ancestry
ideas.vision: Draw many-to-many successor lines when one module becomes several, or vice versa.

ideas.title: Name-change immunity
ideas.vision: Preserve identity when a symbol or package gets renamed.

ideas.title: Executable promise cards
ideas.vision: Turn contracts into understandable promises, each linked to tests and receipts.

ideas.title: Compatibility fingerprint
ideas.vision: Compare public behavior shapes independently of implementation language.

ideas.title: Intent genealogy
ideas.vision: Trace an idea through design, proof, implementation, production and retirement.

ideas.title: Authority DNA
ideas.vision: Attach the effect owner and permission model to every capability's identity.

ideas.title: Ghost capability detector
ideas.vision: Identify code that appears present but has no proven reachable entrypoint.

ideas.title: The uncertainty gene
ideas.vision: Treat ambiguity itself as a tracked, explainable feature of identity lineage.

ideas.title: Architecture terrarium
ideas.vision: A quiet, living view in which dependencies grow, branch and fade across versions.

ideas.title: Evidence x-ray
ideas.vision: Switch layers between copied source, typed contracts, tests, effects and runtime receipts.

ideas.title: Confidence halos
ideas.vision: Use clearly labeled visual halos for certainty, with accessible text equivalents.

ideas.title: Pathfinder ribbons
ideas.vision: Follow one capability across repositories, languages and dates like a metro route.

ideas.title: Change choreography
ideas.vision: Animate architectural deltas as a controlled sequence, not overwhelming particle noise.

ideas.title: The provenance microscope
ideas.vision: Zoom smoothly from an executive explanation down to exact blob and line.

ideas.title: The blank canvas
ideas.vision: Make an unrun comparison look intentionally beautiful, not suspiciously broken.

ideas.title: Pocket-to-desktop continuity
ideas.vision: Same pinned query and evidence story on phone and Windows through TierFlow.

ideas.title: Architecture weather map
ideas.vision: Display where evidence is thin or contracts drift, without fake forecasts.

ideas.title: A thousand repos, one map
ideas.vision: Progressive multi-resolution visualization of approved source universes.

ideas.title: Worldline explorer
ideas.vision: Examine alternative architecture hypotheses beside observed history.

ideas.title: What-if a port never happened?
ideas.vision: Reason about possible dependency differences without executing changes.

ideas.title: Future compatibility sketch
ideas.vision: Project likely contract collisions from proposed signatures, visibly hypothetical.

ideas.title: Evolution pressure map
ideas.vision: Show which interfaces carry the greatest future coordination burden.

ideas.title: Migration gravity
ideas.vision: Reveal features that repeatedly accumulate duplicate implementations.

ideas.title: Architecture trade-off gallery
ideas.vision: Compare imagined configurations by explicit assumptions, never invented results.

ideas.title: Proof debt forecast
ideas.vision: Explore where changes would require new validation to remain trustworthy.

ideas.title: Reversible proposal sculpture
ideas.vision: Compose a visual change hypothesis before deciding whether to write a spec.

ideas.title: Constraint-aware ideation
ideas.vision: A future assistant can brainstorm within Host/TierFlow/Rust authority invariants.

ideas.title: The alternative's cost
ideas.vision: Show unknown cost surfaces before anyone pretends to estimate performance.

ideas.title: Ask without teaching
ideas.vision: Agent discovers installed comparison tools and asks only for missing authorization.

ideas.title: Question-to-evidence compiler
ideas.vision: Translate a human question into pinned source scope and explainable checks.

ideas.title: Evidence appetite control
ideas.vision: Offer low/medium/deep bounded exploration levels at user invocation.

ideas.title: Why-not answers
ideas.vision: Explain why HQ refused access or couldn't prove equivalence, without blaming user.

ideas.title: Human verdict handshake
ideas.vision: Let owners approve equivalence decisions with durable, auditable provenance.

ideas.title: Socratic code archaeologist
ideas.vision: Ask one good clarifying question only when ambiguity changes the result.

ideas.title: Personal research lens
ideas.vision: Remember a user's preferred explanation depth without retaining secret source data.

ideas.title: Portable explanation bundle
ideas.vision: Export a self-contained redacted evidence narrative and its source pins.

ideas.title: The one-minute museum tour
ideas.vision: An agent can introduce a subsystem's evolution in sixty seconds.

ideas.title: Quiet readiness
ideas.vision: The system advertises it *could* compare; it does not prefetch or monitor by default.

ideas.title: Differential provenance engine
ideas.vision: Track evidence lineage through each transformation, adapter and report.

ideas.title: Reproducibility crystal
ideas.vision: A report can be regenerated from immutable manifests without donor checkout.

ideas.title: Typed semantic ABI atlas
ideas.vision: View interface compatibility across native and browser boundaries.

ideas.title: Incremental lineage cache
ideas.vision: Reuse valid immutable comparison sub-results while respecting authorization.

ideas.title: Constrained proof synthesizer
ideas.vision: Suggest tests that would close an evidence gap; never label them executed.

ideas.title: Negative-space inventory
ideas.vision: Represent what is inaccessible, excluded or unobserved as carefully as what's found.

ideas.title: Evidence conflict detector
ideas.vision: Surface contradictory schema, test and author claims instead of choosing silently.

ideas.title: Computational carbon lens
ideas.vision: Show actual measured cost of an analysis when measurements exist.

ideas.title: Epistemic debugger
ideas.vision: Expose which source claim or adapter made an explanation too confident.

ideas.title: Universal software passport
ideas.vision: An exportable, privacy-scoped capability identity portable across organizations.
